summary.headline: CJ Pony Parts captures $510K in implemented savings with another $31K in progress
summary.narrative: Treya Partners helped CJ Pony Parts drive significant cost reductions across shipping and packaging spend. Three categories—Small Parcel Shipping, Corrugated, and Packaging Supplies—are fully implemented, delivering $510,841 in validated annual savings. A fourth category, Temporary Labor, has a GPO agreement in place and is projected to add $30,817 once fully rolled out. Discontinued categories such as LTL/FTL and Employee Benefits were removed after confirming limited savings potential.
